data.description: 剧场公演的舞台上，星野爱换上露肩粉裙与蓝领结，手指轻点唇边抛出一个飞吻，白丝与黑鞋在追光下划出利落的弧线——「这份心意，要好好收下哦。」
data.promptProse: Center stage during a dazzling theater performance at night, Hoshino Ai shines in her off-shoulder pink idol dress, blue necktie, and white thigh-highs beneath a brilliant follow spotlight. Holding her handheld microphone down at one side, she touches her free fingertips playfully to her lips and winks toward the audience to send a sparkling blown kiss. Vibrant stage beams and glowing backlights halo her silhouette across the darkened concert hall.
data.title: 星野爱 · 剧场公演
data.animaCaption: Standing center stage beneath a dazzling follow spotlight in her off-shoulder pink idol costume, Ai holds her microphone in one hand and touches her lips to blow a winking kiss toward the audience. Bright concert beams flare behind her across the theater.
